value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical highly symmetric graph, and its ordinary matching complex already has a nontrivial mixed-dimensional nonequivariant homotopy classification. A pair of equal five-dimensional Betti groups does not reveal that degree-two homology is the reducible sign-twisted label-permutation representation while degree-three homology is the irreducible Specht (3,2). The formulas classify all 120 natural automorphisms and produce distinct rational homology outcomes for quotients by S5 and A5. These natural exact symmetry invariants have a clear use beyond raw dimensions. The scope is finite and neither routine renaming nor an arbitrary unmotivated parameter slice; no unproved downstream theorem is asserted.
